description: This Java class 'SpmService' provides service methods for managing 'Survey' entities within the Apache Fineract platform, including fetching, creating, updating, activating, and deactivating surveys, with data integrity handling.

classes.name: SpmService
classes.description: Service class for managing Survey entities, including CRUD operations and activation/deactivation, with data integrity exception handling.

methods.name: fetchValidSurveys
methods.description: Fetches active surveys for the current tenant after authenticating the user.

methods.name: fetchAllSurveys
methods.description: Fetches all surveys after authenticating the user.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a survey by ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: createSurvey
methods.description: Creates a new survey, deactivates previous survey with same key, sets validity period, and handles data integrity issues.

methods.name: updateSurvey
methods.description: Updates an existing survey with validation and data integrity handling.

methods.name: deactivateSurvey
methods.description: Deactivates a survey by setting its validTo date to yesterday.

methods.name: activateSurvey
methods.description: Activates a survey by setting its validFrom to today and validTo to 100 years from today.

methods.name: getStartOfToday
methods.description: Returns the start date of the current day for the tenant.
